invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter is used in logging and error handling, so should not be null.
The keys list is operated upon directly; passing null would result in a NullPointerException.
config is used to access configuration values without null checks.
table is dereferenced immediately (table.getIndex()), so should not be null.
deleteExecutor is used for both the delete operation and fallback path, so should not be null.
